grammar.summary: 本课学习 shall 提议与 a little/a few 的区别。

points.title: Shall we...? 提议句
points.explanation: Shall I/we + 动词原形表提议：Shall we go for a walk? 比 Let's 更客气，回答 Good idea! / I'd love to.（would love to 接动名词）。

examples.en: Shall we go for a walk?

points.title: a little 与 a few
points.explanation: a little + 不可数（a little money/time），a few + 可数复数（a few friends）。口语中可单独做副词：I'm a little tired.

examples.en: We could have a few drinks first.
